description: Figure 3 presents the distribution of different input stimulus types provided by journalists to Large Language Models (LLMs), as observed in WildChat conversations matched to online articles from two news agencies. The pie chart consists of six slices, representing the following categories: Press Release (18.7%), Social Media Post (26.4%), Email (13.1%), Draft/Other (19.4%), External News Article (14.9%), and Organizational Report (7.2%). The slices are colored in shades of blue and purple. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The chart includes a legend identifying each stimulus type and its corresponding color. The slices appear to be ordered in descending order based on their proportional size, starting with Social Media Post as the largest and ending with Organizational Report as the smallest.
